title: filix-mas fragrans
intro: Filix-mas fragrans, commonly known as Fragrant Male Fern, is a species of fern native to the Himalayan region and parts of Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat skin conditions such as eczema and psoriasis, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Fragrant Male Fern include its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which may help protect against cell damage and infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
